diseases.name: Testicular torsion
diseases.inv: Emergency urology review; do not delay for ultrasound if clinically suspected.

diseases.name: Epididymo-orchitis
diseases.inv: Urine test, STI screen, ultrasound if doubt about torsion.
diseases.tool: Torsion must be excluded first, especially in young males.

diseases.name: Strangulated inguinal hernia
diseases.inv: Emergency surgical review.

diseases.name: Fournier gangrene
diseases.inv: Emergency surgical review, antibiotics, resuscitation.

diseases.name: Hydrocele
diseases.inv: Scrotal ultrasound to exclude tumour or hernia.

diseases.name: Varicocele
diseases.inv: Examination standing, Valsalva; ultrasound; semen analysis if fertility concern.

diseases.name: Testicular cancer
diseases.inv: Urgent scrotal ultrasound, tumour markers, urology referral.

diseases.name: Inguinoscrotal hernia
diseases.inv: Clinical; surgical review.

diseases.name: Acute urinary retention
diseases.inv: Catheterise, check creatinine and electrolytes, find the cause.
diseases.alt: Constipation, cauda equina, drug effect, clot retention

diseases.name: Drug-induced retention
diseases.inv: Medicine review.

diseases.name: Urethral stricture
diseases.inv: Uroflowmetry, urethrogram or urethroscopy.

diseases.name: Stress urinary incontinence
diseases.inv: Clinical, cough stress test, urine test.

diseases.name: Overactive bladder / urge incontinence
diseases.inv: Urine test, bladder diary; exclude infection, stone and diabetes.

diseases.name: Overflow incontinence
diseases.inv: Bladder scan, creatinine, ultrasound.

diseases.name: Vesicovaginal fistula
diseases.inv: Dye test and urology/gynaecology referral.

diseases.name: Genital warts
diseases.inv: Clinical; STI screen; examine partner.

diseases.name: Balanitis
diseases.inv: Clinical; check glucose; swab if persistent.

diseases.name: Penile cancer
diseases.inv: Urgent urology referral and biopsy.

diseases.name: Phimosis
diseases.inv: Clinical.

diseases.name: Paraphimosis
diseases.inv: Emergency reduction by trained clinician.

diseases.name: Male-factor infertility
diseases.inv: Semen analysis (WHO method), hormones, scrotal examination.
diseases.tool: WHO semen reference values guide interpretation.

diseases.name: Tubal-factor infertility
diseases.inv: Hysterosalpingography or laparoscopy; screen for TB if relevant.

flags.text: Sudden severe testicular pain: possible torsion, emergency urology review within hours
Scrotal or perineal pain with redness and illness: possible Fournier gangrene, emergency
Painful irreducible groin lump with vomiting: possible strangulated hernia, emergency
Foreskin stuck behind the glans with painful swollen glans: paraphimosis, urgent reduction
Acute painful inability to pass urine: catheterise and check creatinine
